objective: Run the pre-registered native rules (random, sight of radius 1-3, most and fewest states with the same dissonance, the outside-distance reference) on the class-forced tori's least states, with exact counts, and read F1-F3.
status: Supported 2026-11-10 (exploratory, pre-registered; computed on the two Fano tori and 57 thin tori up to 40 points): native signals steer learning to the over-agreeing face without the outside distance. Sight of the learner's own moves (radius 1-3) and the number of states that share the state's dissonance (most states, R4/R5) resolved every run and beat random moves on every torus of at least 10 points (at 40 points 12.9 and 17.9-19.3 steps against 64.4; the outside distance 7.5). The count is 2 far from the over-agreeing face and grows near it, unevenly at contact (the strict diagnostic fails on six tori); the fewest-states control never resolves on the Fano tori. Stress test to 46 points passed.
title: Native signals that steer learning to the over-agreeing face
